description: The chart illustrates the distribution of three categories - Context, Generated Response, and Other - across two groups, "Ours" and "Standard". The value axis is labeled with percentages and ranges from 0% to 100%, with the bars displaying the proportion of each category within the respective groups. For the "Ours" group, the Context category is represented by a blue bar at 60.6%, Generated Response by an orange bar at 31.7%, and Other by a green bar at 7.7%. In contrast, the "Standard" group has a blue bar for Context at 23.6%, an orange bar for Generated Response at 51.1%, and a green bar for Other at 25.3%. The bars are stacked horizontally, with each component representing a distinct category as indicated by the legend. The chart does not display any specific sorting order, and no bars are visually emphasized.
